responses: Hello! 👋 Welcome to Datheon Shop support. How can I help you today?
Hi there! What can I do for you today?
Hey! Ask me about shipping, returns, payments, warranty or opening hours.
We're open Monday to Friday 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM, and closed on Sunday.
Our support team is available Mon-Fri 9 AM - 6 PM and Sat 10 AM - 4 PM. We're closed on Sundays.
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days and is free on orders over $50. Express shipping (1-2 days) costs $12.
We ship worldwide! Domestic orders arrive in 3-5 business days, international orders in 7-14 days.
You can return any unused item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Just keep your receipt!
Returns are free within 30 days. Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal and Apple Pay. All payments are encrypted.
You can pay by credit/debit card or PayPal at checkout. We don't accept cash or cheques online.
All products include a 12-month manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship.
Your item is covered by a 1-year warranty. If it's defective, contact us with your order number and we'll repair or replace it.
You can reach us at support@datheonshop.example or call +1 (555) 010-0199 during business hours.
Contact our team by email at support@datheonshop.example, or phone +1 (555) 010-0199 (Mon-Fri, 9 AM - 6 PM).
You can track your order using the tracking link in your confirmation email, or in 'My Orders' on our website.
Once your order ships we email you a tracking number. Check 'My Orders' for live status.
You're welcome! 😊 Anything else I can help with?
Happy to help! Let me know if you have any other questions.
My pleasure! 🙌
